welcome.title: Welcome to Puntos Club!
welcome.text: Let's take a quick tour to help you get started. We'll show you the key features to set up your loyalty program.

qrCode.title: Your QR Code
qrCode.text: Share this QR code in your store. Customers scan it to join your loyalty program and start earning points right away.

pointsRules.title: Points Rules
pointsRules.text: Define how your customers earn points — by purchase amount, number of visits, or specific products.

branches.title: Branches
branches.text: Manage all your store locations. Each branch can have its own settings and QR code.

products.title: Products
products.text: Set up your product catalog. Products can be linked to points rules for custom earning rates.

beneficiaries.title: Clients
beneficiaries.text: View and manage all your enrolled customers and track their points balances.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.text: Engage your customers with targeted messages, promotions, and loyalty updates.

complete.title: You're all set!
complete.text: Your loyalty program is ready to go. Explore the dashboard at your own pace — everything is just a click away.
